Its interp now reads on at the first abscissa as numpy's does, and both engines reach 194,143 ohm-m at 14.4325 percent. Perturbing Python's forward model by 1e-15 to 1e-10 moves its answer by at most 4.2e-6. The case is replayed in full, the poorly resolved boundaries included, because on this sheet the answer is not a knife-edge.
